question:
Simple interest on a certain sum is one-fourth of the sum and the interest rate percentage per annum is 4 times the numbers of years. If the rate of interest increases by 2%, then what will be the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹5,000 for 3 years?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 1,800.

SI = \(\frac{1}{4}\)P 

.:. \(\frac{1}{4}\)P = \(\frac{P\times R\times T}{100}\) 

T = 25/R

R = 4T = 4 × 25/R 

⇒ R2 = 100

⇒ R = 10% 

SI =\(\frac{5000\ \times\ 12\ \times\ 3}{100}\) = ₹1800
question_hi:
किसी राशि पर साधारण ब्याज, राशि का एक चौथाई है और प्रतिशत प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर, वर्षों की संख्या की 4 गुनी है। यदि ब्याज की दर में 2% की वृद्धि होती है, तो ₹5,000 पर 3 वर्षों में कितना साधारण ब्याज प्राप्त होगा?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 1,800 है।

SI = \(\frac{1}{4}\)P 

.:. \(\frac{1}{4}\)P = \(\frac{P\times R\times T}{100}\) 

T = 25/R

R = 4T = 4 × 25/R 

⇒ R2 = 100

⇒ R = 10% 

SI =\(\frac{5000\ \times\ 12\ \times\ 3}{100}\) = ₹1800

question:
On simple interest, a certain sum becomes ₹59,200 in 6 years and ₹72,000 in 10 years. If the rate of interest had been 2% more, then in how many years would the sum have become ₹76,000? 

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 9.

SI of 4 years = 72000-59200 = ₹12800
SI of 1 year = \(\frac{12800}{4}\) = ₹3200
Principal  = 59200 - 6 × 3200 
= ₹40000 
R%= \(\frac{3200}{40000}\) × 100% = 8% 
New R% = 8% + 2% = 10%
.:. SI = 76000 - 40000 = 36000 
.:. 36000 = \(\frac{40000\ \times\ 10\times T}{100}\) 
T = 9 years
question_hi:
साधारण ब्याज पर कोई राशि 6 वर्षों में ₹59,200 और 10 वर्षों में ₹72,000 हो जाती है। यदि ब्याज की दर 2% अधिक होती, तो कितने वर्षों में यह राशि ₹76,000 हो जाती?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 9 है।

4 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज = 72000-59200 = ₹12800
1 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज =\(\frac{12800}{4}\) = ₹3200
मूलधन = 59200 - 6 × 3200
= ₹40000
दर%= \(\frac{3200}{40000}\)× 100% = 8%
नयी दर % = 8% + 2% = 10%
.:. साधारण ब्याज = 76000 - 40000 = 36000
.:. 36000 =\(\frac{40000\ \times\ 10\times T}{100}\) 
T = 9 वर्ष

question:
A certain sum amounts to ₹81840 in 3 years and to ₹92400 in 5 years at x% p.a under simple interest. If the rate of interest becomes (x + 2)% , then in how many years will the same sum double itself?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 10.

SI for 1 year = \(\frac{10560}{2}\) = ₹5280 
SI for 3 years = 5280 × 3 = ₹15840 
P = A - SI 
= 81840 -15840 = ₹66000
R%= \(\frac{5280}{66000}\)× 100% = 8% 
New R = (x + 2)% = 10% 
SI = \(\frac{P\times R\times T}{100}\)
(P = SI)
66000 = \(\frac{66000\ \times\ 10\ \times\ T}{100}\)
T = 10 years
question_hi:
x% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर पर, कोई निश्चित राशि 3 वर्ष में ₹81,840 और 5 वर्ष में ₹92400 हो जाती है। यदि ब्याज दर (x + 2)% हो जाती है, तो कितने वर्ष में वही राशि स्वयं की दोगुनी हो जाएगी?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 10 है।

1 वर्ष के लिए साधारण ब्याज =\(\frac{10560}{2}\)= ₹5280
3 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज = 5280 × 3 = ₹15840
P = A - SI
= 81840 -15840 = ₹66000
R%= \(\frac{5280}{66000}\)× 100% = 8%
नया R = (x + 2)% = 10%
साधारण ब्याज = \(\frac{P\times R\times T}{100}\)
(P = साधारण ब्याज)
66000 =\(\frac{66000\ \times\ 10\ \times\ T}{100}\)
T = 10 वर्ष

question:
The difference in simple interest from two banks on ₹8,000 in 3 years is ₹800. If the rate of interest per annum in two banks is R1 and R2, then what is the value of R1 - R2? (Where R1>R2) 

(CGL MAINS 2022)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 3\(\frac{1}{3}\)%.

Difference of one year SI = ₹\(\frac{800}{3}\) 
 (R₁-R₂)% = \(\frac{\frac{800}{3}}{8000}× 100 = 3\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{3}}\%\)
question_hi:

(CGL MAINS 2022)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 3\(\frac{1}{3}\)% है।

एक वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज का अंतर = ₹\(\frac{800}{3}\)
 (R₁-R₂)% = \(\frac{\frac{800}{3}}{8000}× 100 = 3\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{3}}\%\)

question:
A certain sum is lent at 4% p.a. for 3 years, 8% p.a. for the next 4 years, and 12% p.a. beyond 7 years. If for a period of 11 years, the simple interest obtained is ₹27,600, then the sum is (in ₹):

(CGL MAINS 2019)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 30,000.

Let, Principal = 100
SI for 3 years = 3 × 4% = 12% 
SI for next 4 years = 4 × 8% = 32% 
SI for next 4 years = 4 × 12% = 48% 
SI for whole 11 years = 12% + 32% + 48% = 92% = ₹ 27600
1% = 300
100% = ₹30,000
question_hi:
कोई निश्चित राशि, 3 वर्ष के लिए 4% वार्षिक दर पर, अगले 4 वर्ष के लिए 8% वार्षिक दर पर और 7 वर्ष के बाद 12% वार्षिक दर पर उधार दी जाती है। यदि 11 वर्ष की अवधि में, प्राप्त साधारण ब्याज, ₹27,600 है, तो राशि में (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।

(CGL MAINS 2019)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 30,000 है।

माना मूलधन = 100
3 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज = 3 × 4% = 12%
अगले 4 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज = 4 × 8% = 32%
अगले 4 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज = 4 × 12% = 48%
पूरे 11 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज = 12% + 32% + 48% = 92% = ₹ 27600
1% = 300
100% = ₹30,000

question:
A sum of ₹5,000 is divided into two parts such that the simple interest on the first part for 4\(\frac{1}{5}\) years  at 6\(\frac{2}{3}\)% p.a is double  the simple interest on the second part for 2\(\frac{3}{4}\) years at 4% p.a. What is the difference (in ₹) between the two parts?

(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 600.

\(\frac{A\ \times\frac{20}{3}\times\frac{21}{5}}{100}=2\times\frac{B\ \times\ 4\ \times\frac{11}{4}}{100}\)

14A = 11B
\(\frac{A}{B}\)=\(\frac{11}{14}\)
25 unit = ₹5000
1 unit = ₹200
Diff (14-11) = 3 unit = 200×3 = ₹600
question_hi:
₹5000 की राशि को दो भागो में इस प्रकार विभाजित किया जाता है कि पहले भाग पर 6\(\frac{2}{3}\)% प्रतिवर्ष की दर से 4\(\frac{1}{5}\) वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज, दूसरे भाग पर 4% प्रतिवर्ष की दर से 2\(\frac{3}{4}\) वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज से दोगुना है। दोनो भागो में कितना अंतर है (₹ में)?

(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 600 है।

\(\frac{A\ \times\frac{20}{3}\times\frac{21}{5}}{100}=2\times\frac{B\ \times\ 4\ \times\frac{11}{4}}{100}\)

14A = 11B
\(\frac{A}{B}\)=\(\frac{11}{14}\)
25 इकाई = ₹5000
1 इकाई = ₹200
अंतर (14-11) = 3 इकाई = 200×3 = ₹600

question:
A man borrowed a certain sum of money at the rate of 10% per annum simple interest for the first three years and 15% per annum simple interest for the period beyond three years. If he pays a total interest of ₹2,884.50 at the end of 7 years, then the sum of money (in ₹) that he borrowed is:

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 3,205.

Combined rate of interest for 7 years = 10 × 3 + 15 × 4 = 90%
.:. 90% = ₹2884.50 

⇒1% = \(2884.50 \over 90\) = ₹32.05
Sum = 100% × 32.05 = ₹3205 
.:. He borrowed ₹3205
question_hi:

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 3,205 है।

7 वर्षों के लिए संयुक्त ब्याज दर = 10 × 3 + 15 × 4 = 90%
.:. 90% =  ₹2884.50

⇒1% = \(2884.50 \over 90\) = ₹32.05
धनराशि = 100% × 32.05 = ₹3205

question:
Two equal sums are lent at 10% and 8% simple interest p.a. respectively, at the same time. The first sum is received 2 years earlier than the second one and the amount received in each case was 36,900. Each sum was ___

(СРО 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. ₹20,500.

Principal = P
\(\frac{P\ \times\ 10\times y}{100}=\frac{P\ \times\ 8\times\left(y\ +\ 2\right)}{100}\) 
10Py = 8Py + 16P 
2Py = 16P 
y = 8 
36900 = \(\frac{P\ \times\ 10\ \times\ 8}{100}\) + P 
36900×100 = 180P 
Principal = ₹20,500

(СРО 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात ₹20,500 है।

मूलधन = P
\(\frac{P\ \times\ 10\times y}{100}=\frac{P\ \times\ 8\times\left(y\ +\ 2\right)}{100}\) 
10Py = 8Py + 16P 
2Py = 16P 
y = 8 
36900 = \(\frac{P\ \times\ 10\ \times\ 8}{100}\) + P 
36900×100 = 180P 
मूलधन = ₹20,500

question:
A sum of ₹15,000 is invested partly at 12% per annum and the remaining at 10% per annum simple interest. If the total interest at the end of 2 years is ₹3,344 how much money was invested at 10% per annum.

(CPO 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. ₹6,400.

Interest of 1 year ⇒ \(\frac{3344}{2}\) = ₹1672

  A       :        B
12%    :     (12% - 2)% = 10% 
If the total is invested at 12%, then the interest will be =\( \frac{12}{100}\) × 15000 = ₹1800 
Extra interest = 1800-1672 = ₹128
It has become 2%
2% of B = ₹128 
.:. B = ₹6400

Alternatively:-

(43+32) unit = ₹15000
32 unit = \(\frac{32}{75}\)×15000 = ₹6400
question_hi:

(CPO 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:

1 वर्ष का ब्याज ⇒ \(\frac{3344}{2}\) = ₹1672

  A       :        B
12%    :     (12% - 2)% = 10% 
यदि कुल राशि को 12% पर निवेश किया जाए तो ब्याज होगा = \( \frac{12}{100}\)× 15000 = ₹1800
अतिरिक्त ब्याज = 1800-1672 = ₹128
यह 2% हो गया है
B का 2%= ₹128 
.:. B = ₹6400

वैकल्पिक :-

(43+32) इकाई = ₹15000
32 इकाई = \(\frac{32}{75}\)×15000 = ₹6400

₹7000 पर साधारण ब्याज = 7000 × \(5 \over 100\)  = ₹350
₹6000 पर साधारण ब्याज = 6000 × \(6 \over 100\) = ₹360
तीसरे भाग पर साधारण ब्याज = 1160 – 350 - 360 = ₹450
तीसरा भाग =18000 – 7000 - 6000 = ₹5000

R = 9%

question:
A sum of money earns a simple interest at 7.25% per annum for the first eight years, at 8.5% for the next six years, and at 6.5% for the final four years. If the total interest earned during these eighteen years was ₹35,100, what was original sum invested (in ₹)? 

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 26,000.

Total interest in percentage given is = 7.25% × 8 + 8.5% × 6 + 6.5% × 4 
⇒ 58% + 51% + 26% = 135%

question:

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 4,80,000.

25 = \(\frac{100\ \times\ R\ \times\ 3}{100}\)
